notes.text: Gamliel son of Rabbi Elai asks Rabbi Mana about interpreting the earlier Rabban Gamliel’s conduct.
The parallel question reads Gamliel bei Rabbi Avina in the checked witness.
The checked wording is one of the house of Gamliel bei Rabbi Liyani. It concerns the firstborn status of the subsequent child.
Gamliel bar Inya asks how often one gives a fifth. The variant reflects a distinct printed name form.
This witness gives bar Ininya asking Rabbi Mana about giving a fifth annually.
The previous discussion names both Gamliel ben Ininya and Abba bar Kahana, with individual attribution of the two views unstated.
This witness gives the fuller name Rabbi Gamliel bar Inyaina. The content of his report differs from the charity discussion.
